acceptance.given: The Package A repair is configured with a controlling validator and its frozen VDD handoff requirements.

oracle.expected: The repair configuration records VDD mode self-hosted, limits added fixtures to relevant contract/migration fixtures, and leaves development governance disabled.

Fixtures outside relevant contract or migration coverage are added.
oracle.observable: Inspect the compiled repair configuration and fixture manifest during plan validation.

acceptance.then: The current repair uses self-hosted VDD with development governance off and only the permitted fixture scope.
acceptance.when: Compiling and validating the current VDD repair plan

failure_intents.selector_intent: A plan contract check mutates the repair configuration to use a non-self-hosted mode, enable development governance, or declare out-of-scope fixtures, then asserts a structured validation failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce the frozen self-hosted VDD and development-governance-off repair configuration with bounded fixture scope.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore the prior policy-validation behavior and configuration contract.

slice_hint.state_transition: From unconstrained repair configuration to explicitly self-hosted, governance-off configuration with bounded fixtures.

acceptance.given: A package declares no network, database, subprocess, or secret capability in its quality declaration.

acceptance.then: The no-capability package is accepted without those capability infrastructures.
acceptance.when: Validating a package whose declarations truthfully contain none of the named capabilities

failure_intents.selector_intent: The capability test invokes validate_package on a fixture declaring no named capabilities and asserts the validator does not require network, database, subprocess, or secret infrastructure; the assertion fails if any requirement is imposed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Condition capability checks on truthful declarations so a package declaring none of the named capabilities has no infrastructure prerequisites.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the versioned quality declaration schema and validator result compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: From unconditional capability infrastructure assumptions to declaration-conditioned validation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The no-capability fixture returns a passing structured result without requiring named capability infrastructure.

acceptance.given: The terminal integration test invokes the published validator CLI with a literal argv list, repository working directory, shell disabled, and a finite timeout.

oracle.expected: Fresh CLI stdout parses as one JSON object matching the declared result schema; the reference package is asserted passing and a mutated package is asserted rejected.
forbidden: The test relies only on exit code, text fragments, file existence, or plan status.
Fresh JSON is not parsed or schema-checked.
The reference package is not asserted passing.
The mutated package is not asserted rejected.
oracle.observable: Execute the terminal integration test and inspect its structured assertions over fresh CLI output for both package variants.

acceptance.then: Terminal integration assertions establish schema-valid fresh output, reference-package pass, and mutated-package rejection.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The migration integration selector invokes the published CLI for reference and mutated fixtures, parses stdout JSON, validates the result schema, and asserts pass/reject outcomes; it fails when any assertion is absent or false.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Provide a real CLI integration oracle that validates fresh structured output and distinguishes compliant reference and mutated packages.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep the versioned CLI result shape stable.

slice_hint.state_transition: From weak CLI checking to schema-validated fresh JSON with explicit reference and mutation outcomes.
